title: Evaluation of the Effects of Teleconsultations on a Endocrinology Referral List
brief_summary: The aim of this study is evaluate the effects of telephone teleconsultations to primary care physicians (compared to the state's referral protocol) in the referrals waiting list for endocrinological appointments.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients from counties with at least 5 endocrinology referrals waiting appointment.
* Patients referred from primary care physicians
* Patients referred because one of the protocol conditions (Diabetes Mellitus, Hypothyroidism, Hyperthyroidism, Goiter, Thyroid nodule, Obesity).

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients from counties with more than one hundred endocrinology referrals waiting appointment.
